item.description:
The macOS and Windows desktop packages now share the same release source. This Mac update uses the signed and notarized installer.

Пакети macOS і Windows зібрано з одного коміту. Оновлення Mac містить підписаний і нотаризований інсталятор.

Translate selected text through the system Services menu. The new installer shows where to drag the app. Support the developer from Settings → About.

Перекладайте виділений текст через системне меню «Служби». Новий інсталятор показує, куди перетягнути застосунок. Підтримайте розробника в розділі «Про програму».

The source and target languages sit above their respective panes, with the swap button centered over the divider. The text fields for translation and writing have more room around the text.

Мови оригіналу й перекладу розміщено над відповідними панелями. Кнопка обміну мов тепер над розділювачем. У полях перекладу й покращення тексту збільшено внутрішні відступи.

Turn on Open at login in Settings → Behavior to start DeepL-oFM when you sign in to macOS. The logo and tabs now align with the language picker.

Увімкніть Налаштування → Поведінка → Запускати під час входу в macOS, щоб DeepL-oFM відкривався автоматично. Логотип і вкладки вирівняні за лівим краєм перемикача мов.

Opening the app again brings back its window. Stop a translation while it runs. The app spends less time processing long responses and keeps the window responsive while it opens or writes a file.

Text and Markdown retain paragraph breaks. Fenced code stays intact. If a save fails, you can try again with the same translation.

Повторний запуск відкриває наявне вікно. Переклад можна зупинити. Файли відкриваються і зберігаються у фоновому режимі. Порожні рядки та блоки коду Markdown зберігаються.

# DeepL-oFM 1.1.2
File translation is faster and survives provider limits.
- **Fallback works in Files**: if the primary provider fails, the configured fallback provider and model continue the document, and the form shows which fallback is active. - **One request per paragraph**, not per line: a three-line paragraph is one request. - **Rate limits**: a 429 is shown as a short message, and cloud file requests are paced and retried instead of failing the document.

# DeepL-oFM 1.1.1
File translation lives only in the Files tab.
- Removed the in-window File menu; the Files tab is the single place to choose a document, pick the target language and translate it. - Removed the global drop target from the translation view, so a file can no longer be dropped into the text/chat screen.

# DeepL-oFM 1.1.0
Percentage progress, a dedicated Files form, DeepL Write and better speech.
- **Percentage progress**: the text and file translation bars show 0–100%. - **Files tab**: choose a document, pick the target language and translate with a progress bar. The result is created as `name_<language>.<extension>` (for example `report_uk.pdf`) and Save writes it wherever you need. The document text stays out of the translation panes. - **DeepL Write**: improve clarity, grammar and style while keeping the meaning. - **Speech**: choose an installed system voice and stop playback at any time. - **Dock icon**: shown while the window is open, hidden again when the window is closed in menu-bar-only mode.

# DeepL-oFM 1.0.10
The window comes back, and the iPhone app is here.
- **Window reopen fix**: closing the window keeps DeepL-oFM in the menu bar; the clipboard hotkey (⌥⌘T) and the menu bar item bring it back instead of leaving the app active without a window. - **iPhone app source**: `ios/` now contains a SwiftUI app with the same translation core, nine interface languages, cloud providers and a custom LAN endpoint. Build it with XcodeGen and Xcode; instructions are in `ios/README.md`. - All nine README editions include localized screenshots and the demo GIF.

# DeepL-oFM 1.0.9
Menu-bar-only mode and documentation in nine languages.
- **Dock icon switch**: hide DeepL-oFM from the Dock and keep it in the menu bar. If the menu bar icon is off, turning off the Dock icon enables it automatically. - **Nine README editions** with localized screenshots and the demo GIF: English, Ukrainian, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese and Italian. - Each edition links to all the others, and the website links the full documentation in every language.

# DeepL-oFM 1.0.8
Nine interface languages, a Markdown view, and file translation that keeps the original document.
- Interface in English, Ukrainian, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese and Italian. - Three result views: rendered Markdown, plain text without markup, and the raw Markdown source. Copy follows the active view. - Rich paste: HTML/RTF from a browser or a word processor becomes Markdown, so headings, lists, links and emphasis survive translation. - File translation for `.txt`, `.md`, `.pdf` and `.docx`, from the File menu or by dropping a file onto the window. - DOCX is updated in place — only `word/document.xml` changes — so styles, images, tables, headers and fonts stay untouched. - PDF keeps the original pages, layout, images and typography; the translation is drawn into the same text blocks. - Refined style and tone selectors, Settings in the ⋯ menu (Escape returns to translation), and a fix for model ids at the end of a sentence.
Signed and notarized DMG; the previous 1.0.7 installs this update through Sparkle.

# DeepL-oFM 1.0.7
Fallback provider, automatic preload, better Groq support and wider text.
- **Fallback provider/model**: if the primary provider fails, the same text is retried automatically with the fallback you choose. The status bar shows a “fallback” chip. - **Load the translator at launch**: connects to the provider, refreshes the model list and warms up a local model. Can be disabled in Behavior. - **Groq fix**: Unicode hyphens in model IDs (`Hy‑MT2`) no longer make the app discard a valid translation and fall back to the untranslated source. - **History tab** disappears when “Keep translation history” is off. - **Typography**: wider text panes and larger line spacing. - Signed and notarized DMG with an Applications shortcut; Sparkle update feed.
If you are on 1.0.6, this is the first update delivered through Sparkle.
